_comment: The lab's platform architecture: the one source for the Lab Companion Architecture tab and Data map, the written guide's C2 page, and the Mermaid diagram in core/C2_data_product_tour.md (regenerated by guide/build_guide.py). Lanes run left to right in data-flow order; module codes link to the modules. Icons are lucide-react names.
